title: 雪豹数量翻倍背后的保护行动
subtitle: 从栖息地到社区参与，看中国雪豹保护

article.en:
China's snow leopard population has doubled to about 5,000 since systematic protection began in 2013. The animal now lives in a habitat of about 2.08 million square kilometers, which is more than 60 percent of the world's snow leopard habitat. Officials also say China has the largest population and the largest distribution area of the species on earth.

To protect snow leopards, China has set up two national parks and 78 other key protected areas in the main habitats. More than 800,000 square kilometers of snow leopard land is under strict protection, and close to 40 percent of the possible habitat is under standard management. The Helan Mountains project shows the results. Eight snow leopards were released into the wild there, and in 2026 a cub was born and survived.

Still, the work is far from easy. Climate change, habitat fragmentation and conflicts between people and animals remain serious problems. Researchers need to monitor the animals, find the core habitats and the paths they use to move, and the government should also improve its laws and bring local people into the work.
article.zh: 自2013年系统保护工作启动以来，中国雪豹数量已翻倍至约5000只。如今，雪豹的栖息地面积约为208万平方公里，占全球雪豹栖息地的六成以上。官方还表示，中国拥有全球数量最多、分布面积最大的雪豹种群。 为保护雪豹，中国已在主要栖息地设立两个国家公园和78个其他重要保护区。超过80万平方公里的雪豹区域已纳入严格保护，接近40%的潜在栖息地实行标准化管理。贺兰山项目就是明证：八只雪豹被放归野外，2026年更有一只幼崽在野外出生并存活下来。 不过，这项工作仍远非轻松。气候变化、栖息地破碎化和人兽冲突依然是不小的难题。研究人员需要监测雪豹，找出核心栖息地以及它们迁移的通道，政府也应完善法律并让当地居民参与进来。

vocab.ex: The snow leopard habitat now covers 2.08 million square kilometers.
vocab.note: 四级核心词；注意与 hotel（旅馆）区分

vocab.ex: The population has doubled to about 5,000.
vocab.note: 指动物数量时说 population of + 动物；the number of 后面接复数
protect 名词化，常搭 protection of / under protection

vocab.ex: China has the largest distribution area of the species.
vocab.note: distribution area 指物种分布区；distribute 是动词

vocab.ex: Officials say the population has doubled.
vocab.note: 名词复数 officials 表「官方人士」；形容词义「官方的」

vocab.ex: Eight snow leopards were released into the wild.
vocab.note: be released into the wild 是野生动物放归的固定说法

vocab.ex: More than 800,000 square kilometers is under strict protection.
vocab.note: strict protection / strict control，都是高频搭配

vocab.ex: Conflicts between people and animals remain serious.
vocab.note: human-wildlife conflict 四级外刊高频；conflict with sb

vocab.ex: The species is called the king of the mountains.
vocab.note: 单复数同形，谓语用单数；本义「种类」

vocab.ex: Researchers need to monitor the animals.
vocab.note: 四级常考义；monitor 作名词时是「显示器」

translation.title: 雪豹保护：从数量翻倍到社区共治
translation.brief: 本篇五句取自当天的雪豹保护报道，依次覆盖数据、意义、措施、挑战与对策。注意数字表达和固定搭配。

sentences.cn: 自2013年系统保护工作启动以来，中国雪豹数量已翻倍至约5000只。
sentences.ref: Since systematic conservation work began in 2013, China's snow leopard population has doubled to about 5,000.

hints.struct: Since + 现在完成时 has doubled to

pts.t: Since 引导时间状语从句，主句必须用现在完成时 has doubled，表示从 2013 年持续到现在的结果。
「数量」用 population；不要写成 number of snow leopards（the number of 后面接复数会变成「雪豹的数量」）。
double to 是「翻倍到」；double by 是「翻了一倍」，介词不能混用。
5,000 要加千分位逗号；约数用 about 修饰数字。

sentences.cn: 目前，中国拥有全球六成以上的雪豹栖息地，面积约208万平方公里。
sentences.ref: China now holds more than 60 percent of the world's snow leopard habitat, about 2.08 million square kilometers.

hints.struct: 主语 + hold + 比例 of + 同位语

pts.t: 「占……的」最稳的写法是 hold / account for + 比例 + of + 名词，不要写 has 60 percent of。
more than 60 percent 表示「超过六成」，percent 前面用基数词。
「面积约……」在句中作同位语，用逗号隔开；也可改写成 which covers about 2.08 million square kilometers。
habitat 是「栖息地」四级核心词，注意与 hotel（旅馆）拼写只差一个字母。

sentences.cn: 雪豹被视为高海拔生态系统健康的重要指标，因此保护它们意义重大。
sentences.ref: Snow leopards are considered an important indicator of the health of high-altitude ecosystems, which is why their protection is of great significance.

hints.struct: 被动语态 + which 引导非限制性从句

pts.t: 「被视为」用 be considered / be regarded as，是被动语态；不要写成 people consider that。
indicator of 后接 of + 名词；health 在此作名词，需写成 of the health。
「意义重大」用 be of great significance，这是四级写作的高频倒装结构。
which 引导非限制性定语从句补充原因，前面的逗号不能漏，否则意思会变。

sentences.cn: 为保护雪豹，中国已在核心地区设立两个国家公园和78个其他重要保护区。
sentences.ref: To protect snow leopards, China has set up two national parks and 78 other key protected areas in the core areas.

hints.struct: To + 动词原形 + 主句（现在完成时）

pts.t: 目的状语用 To + 动词原形 开头并加逗号；不要写 So to protect…（so 表结果）。
「设立机构、设施」用 set up；establish 更偏「建立制度、理论」。
数字后加 other，写成 78 other key protected areas，意思是「另外 78 个重点保护区」。
protected areas 是「保护区」的固定搭配，不要写成 protection areas。

sentences.cn: 气候变化、栖息地破碎化和人兽冲突仍构成威胁，未来还需进一步加强监测并鼓励社区参与。
sentences.ref: Climate change, habitat fragmentation and conflicts between people and wildlife still pose threats, so more monitoring and community participation will be needed in the future.

hints.struct: 并列主语 + pose threats + so 结果从句

pts.t: 「构成威胁」用 pose threats，pose 是及物动词，后面必须直接跟 threats。
三个并列名词短语作主语，谓语用复数 pose，不能写成 pose a threat。
「加强监测」可写 more monitoring 或 strengthen monitoring；「社区参与」写 community participation。
will be needed 是被动语态，比 students need 更符合四级书面语。

exprs.note: Since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时。
double to 给结果，double by 给增幅。
四级核心词，指动物或植物的生存环境。
四级高频倒装，of 后接名词。
set up 用于设立机构、设施、平台。
pose threat to sb/sth，threat 用复数。
名词化比名词+动词更稳。
社区参与（保护行动）固定说法。
wildlife 不可数，指野生动物。

pitfalls.title: 倍数与数字搭配错
pitfalls.wrong: The snow leopard population has doubled more than 5,000.
pitfalls.why: double 本身已含「翻倍」义，后面只能接 to 给出结果数量，不能再加 more than。
pitfalls.right: The snow leopard population has doubled to about 5,000.

pitfalls.title: 目的状语写成 so
pitfalls.wrong: So to protect snow leopards, China has set up two national parks.
pitfalls.why: 汉语「为……」表目的，英文用 To + 动词原形；so 表结果，不能接不定式。
pitfalls.right: To protect snow leopards, China has set up two national parks.

pitfalls.title: 定语从句误用
pitfalls.wrong: the areas which snow leopards live
pitfalls.why: which 后缺少宾语，snow leopards 是 live 的主语，要用 where 引导地点状语从句。
pitfalls.right: the areas where snow leopards live

pitfalls.title: 时态与时间状语不搭
pitfalls.wrong: Since 2013, China's snow leopard population doubled to 5,000.
pitfalls.why: Since + 过去时间点通常搭配现在完成时，强调从那时持续到现在的结果。
pitfalls.right: Since 2013, China's snow leopard population has doubled to about 5,000.

pitfalls.title: 「保护区」搭配错
pitfalls.wrong: China set up 78 protection areas for snow leopards.
pitfalls.why: 「保护区」的规范表达是 protected areas，protection area 不是固定搭配。
pitfalls.right: China has set up 78 key protected areas to protect snow leopards.

translation.classroomNote: 课堂速练用的两句（2 句模式默认出这两句；5 句全练出全部）

quiz.q: What has happened to China's snow leopard population since 2013?
opts: It has doubled to about 5,000.
It has halved to about 5,000.
It has tripled to about 5,000.
It has stayed at about 5,000.
quiz.why: 第一段第一句给出核心数据：数量从 2013 年起翻倍至约 5000 只。
quiz.evidence: China's snow leopard population has doubled to about 5,000 since systematic protection began in 2013

quiz.q: How much of the world's snow leopard habitat does China hold?
opts: Less than 30 percent of it.
About 50 percent of it.
Nearly 90 percent of it.
More than 60 percent of it.
quiz.why: 第一段第二句说栖息地占全球雪豹栖息地的 60% 以上。
quiz.evidence: which is more than 60 percent of the world's snow leopard habitat

quiz.q: What has China done to protect snow leopard habitats?
opts: Set up two national parks and 78 protected areas.
Built 500 advanced factories in the habitats.
Moved all snow leopards to the Helan Mountains.
Reduced the number of grazing animals near them.
quiz.why: 第二段第一句列出两项具体举措：两个国家公园和 78 个重点保护区。
quiz.evidence: China has set up two national parks and 78 other key protected areas in the main habitats

quiz.q: What does the Helan Mountains project show?
opts: Eight snow leopards were released into the wild.
The mountains lost their last wild snow leopards.
Eight snow leopards were caught by local farmers.
A robot was used to follow the animals there.
quiz.why: 第二段最后一句说八只雪豹被放归野外，2026 年还有幼崽在野外出生存活。
quiz.evidence: Eight snow leopards were released into the wild there, and in 2026 a cub was born and survived

quiz.q: What challenges does snow leopard conservation still face?
opts: A sharp fall in the number of tourists.
Climate change and conflicts with local people.
The high cost of building new national parks.
The slow growth of industrial production.
quiz.why: 第三段第一句列出气候变化、栖息地破碎化和人兽冲突三大难题。
quiz.evidence: Climate change, habitat fragmentation and conflicts between people and animals remain serious problems
